objectives.description: Describe existence, appearance/disappearance, availability and occurrence without conflating identity with events.
objectives.rationale: Selected presence/absence change, creation/destruction and occurrence predicates; retained earlier finding, loss, cancellation and availability with exact links. A1-F001–005 identity/location/existential/possession and A2-F169–170 birth/death plus P life-stage proposals remain prerequisites. No every-creation-synonym quota; domain-specific manufacture, design and construction detail stays W/H/S. Event-location ser is earlier than B1 and not silently relabeled.

objectives.description: Distinguish certainty, doubt and competing likelihood judgments.
objectives.rationale: Possible/probable/confident inference, explicit impossibility/evidence/doubt and uncertainty noun/verb are enumerated. A1 quizá/ser posible and A2-F004 probable/005 verdad/006 seguro remain earlier meanings; B1 selected mood/complement extensions do not reintroduce those concepts. Epistemic future belongs the bounded form prerequisite; advanced proof/confirmation rhetoric and full past-inference systems remain B2–C2.

objectives.description: Contrast actual events, imagined situations and fiction.
objectives.rationale: Actual/imagined/fiction contrasts are selected as distinct from A2-F186 hard-to-believe and A2-F152 admiration. Dream, imagining and their lexical families are explicit; no blanket A2 fictional taxonomy was claimed. Specialized fantasy genres stay C and philosophical reality analysis stays S.

objectives.description: Distinguish need, obligation, contingency and dependence.
objectives.rationale: Need, mandatory versus optional context, dependence, unavoidable outcomes and contingency have explicit meanings. A2-F007 necesario,108 tener que,109 hay que and A2-T102 obligatorio are reused; no extra word for every negation. Depender de A2-D008 versus B1 planned recommendation is unresolved, not silently frozen. Broad essentiality/indispensability rhetoric stays B2.

objectives.description: Identify a type, relevant property, common pattern and exceptions without implying universality.
objectives.rationale: Category/type, property, apparent attribution/resemblance, usual-pattern generalization and unusual/unfamiliar alternatives are enumerated. Majority/minority quantity links below supply nonuniversal generalization. Type A2-D080 and evaluator parecer A2-D022 matches are explicit. Creative-original and sociological special categories belong C/P/S; a category label is not a quota requiring every synonymous taxonomy noun.

objectives.description: Compose ordinal positions 11–20, simple percentages and everyday arithmetic from earlier cardinal bases.
objectives.rationale: All 10 ordinal positions11–20, basic four arithmetic operations/counting, and percent construction are explicit. Reuse A1-F039–086 cardinal bases through999999 plus standalone million, decimal digit composition and number agreement. B1 forms prerequisite covers ordinary one-decimal percentage reading and I–XX century ordinal/cardinal recognition; not each percentage, operation result, Roman numeral or inflected ordinal as a new word. Unbounded higher ordinals/large scientific values remain W/later.

objectives.description: Express approximate quantities, whole/part relations, upper/lower bounds and increase/decrease.
objectives.rationale: Amount, total, majority/minority, several, approximate numeric unos/sobre/aproximadamente, colloquial large amount/group, half/third/double, and increase/decrease are enumerated. A2-F049–050 thresholds,043–044 tanto, A2-H082 medio/083 cuarto and A1-H units/containers are reused. Exact total A2-S038 and scalar changes A2-S050/051 retain earlier meaning. Equal-share and measured-serving form composition closes the bounded contrasts without every container as a new F word.

objectives.description: Compare degree and emphasize or restrict one relevant property.
objectives.rationale: Highlighting and near-zero scope are selected; A1-F124–128 degree and A2-F035–051 comparative/excess/adequacy/negative degree plus A2-F178 solo supply earlier contrasts. B1 absolute -ísimo and relative el más/menos de, equal-degree igual de + ADJ/ADV + que, negative threshold inclusion and pragmatic diminutive forms are explicit morphology obligations, not an unlimited list of inflections/derivatives. Reinforcing prefixes and extended scalar rhetoric stay B2.

objectives.description: Describe size, depth, weight, speed, capacity and temperature in practical comparisons.
objectives.rationale: Dimension noun/measurement verb, depth/extreme size, mass contrast, capacity/full-empty/fill-empty, moderate temperature and fast/gradual manner are enumerated. A1 height/length/metre/km, A2-F127–133 width/cm/area/speed/weight/clothing-size and A2-F173 grado supply the existing bounded units; H quantities and preparation temperature verbs remain topical dependencies. Pressure/scientific precision is explicitly separately disposed below, not hidden behind one unit example.

objectives.description: Describe relative location, separation, approach and origin in a connected account.
objectives.rationale: Relative interior/exterior/adjacent/separate, empty/universal location, direction/origin and ordered arrangement are enumerated. Earlier A1 deictics/cardinal compass/left-right and A2-F052–064 location/position sets remain prerequisites. A1-T045 origin,175 line and A2-T148 map are explicit. Center/outskirts/front/back are earlier lexical combinations; advanced metaphorical orientation and detailed route infrastructure belong T/later, not implicit synonyms here.

objectives.description: Describe motion, departure, interruption and the direction an action follows.
objectives.rationale: Approach/recede/separate, movement/stop/fall/jump and departure form the selected motion contrasts. A1-T096 stopping, A2-D088 departure and A2-S165 separation retain earlier meanings; B1-P012/032/034 concurrent valency matches are explicit. A1-F219–224 and A2-F066–076 route/transport/cross/turn/walk remain prerequisites. Navigation, riding, road operations and escape/security scenarios belong T/C/P; broader transport mechanics are not required by one generic movement row.

objectives.description: Anchor narration to calendar units, adjacent days and a historical/present/future viewpoint.
objectives.rationale: Present/past/future viewpoint nouns, decade/century, recent-day/night offsets, current/recent-period and day/night conditions plus approximate/prospective anchors are enumerated. A1-F weekdays/months/seasons/clock and A2-F092–098 phase/calendar forms stay earlier. Anoche retains A2 earlier pragmatics evidence. A2-S087 festivo and workplace calendar in W cover working/nonworking schedules; holy-day naming is S, not a new F word per holiday.

objectives.description: Relate simultaneous, preceding and following events with explicit temporal boundaries.
objectives.rationale: Simultaneity, sequential/preceding/following finite clauses, endpoint, immediate sequence, suddenness and conclusion have explicit rows. Earlier A2 cuando/desde que/antes de/después de and A1 before/after are retained prerequisites. Current A2-D093 al final/094 de repente versus baseline B1 is explicit; en cuanto B1 plan versus checked B2 grammar remains unresolved. Before/after future subjunctive, al+infinitive and duration restrictions are bounded form work, not every clause as a word.

objectives.description: Express elapsed duration, deadline and punctuality or delay.
objectives.rationale: Duration taken, punctuality, time pressure, elapsed-duration llevar, allowed deadline, since-then and provisional-now references are enumerated. A2-D087 tener prisa is earlier; A2-T delay/service-time language and A2-F081–091 duration/elapsed/recurrence units remain prerequisites. B1 plazo versus B2 general-notion listing is explicit. Ahead-of-schedule advance-payment nuances, extended period/phase taxonomy and indefinite-duration rhetoric stay B2 or H/T/W.

objectives.description: Distinguish onset, imminence, cessation, continuation, completion and repetition.
objectives.rationale: Onset, imminent onset, cessation, completion, continuation, uninterrupted activity and repeated action are enumerated or explicitly retained from A2. A2-F101–106 ir a/acabar de/empezar a/terminar de/volver a/seguir are not new B1 introductions; their past forms are practice. Selected ponerse a has exact B1 grammar support despite later thematic recurrence. Expanded no dejar de/no parar de persistence, perfect infinitive reproach and unrestricted aspectual paraphrases stay later.

objectives.description: Express recurrent habits and variable frequency without reintroducing an earlier habitual meaning.
objectives.rationale: Habit soler retains A2; often/occasionally/every-occurrence phrase proposals supply additional lexical or construction choices with uncertainty, not a new frequency concept. A1 always/never/sometimes/normalmente and A2 cada/vez/otra vez already compose bounded counted recurrence (once/twice/N times per named day/week/month). B1/B2 general4.3.10–12 reprise and extend systems; no unsupported claim that every chosen frequency phrase is explicitly a B1 lexical item. Unbounded periodic adjectives/derivatives are later or W/C needs, not a quota.

objectives.description: Describe a bounded change of state and persistence; expose limits of later pseudocopular systems.
objectives.rationale: Narrow reaction-onset ponerse and result-state quedarse are explicit proposals against the B2 broad pseudocopular system. Earlier A2-F110–111 cambiar de/cambio and phase ya no/todavía plus A1 siempre support ordinary change/persistence. Physical wet/dry/fill/empty transitions are individually selected or reused. Permanent-trait hacerse/volverse/convertirse and stable/exclusive abstract taxonomies remain B2 comparison, not falsely certified B1 by a short reaction example.

objectives.description: Relate cause, result, purpose, real condition and factual concession.
objectives.rationale: Cause noun, preposed causal como, consequence así que/o sea que, purpose para que, real contingency and factual aunque are selected. Reuse A1 porque/para purpose, A2 por cause/por eso/entonces consequence/si real condition. Same-subject versus finite-subject complements and present-subjunctive future/purpose are required forms. Counterfactual conditions and comprehensive nonfactual concession systems remain B2; higher B2 connector baseline rows are later comparisons only.

objectives.description: Use obligation, permission and possible action with the correct infinitive or finite complement.
objectives.rationale: Obligation/advice deber, immediate-ability poder, finite epistemic puede que and intent pensar are explicit; A2 tener que/soler remain earlier and epistemic deber de is a B2 comparison. Permission A1-D074/A2-D141 poder, A2-F109 hay que and contextual no tener/no hay que (not needed versus forbidden) are bounded prerequisites. Polite conditional/negative-imperative force belongs form/D QA, not one sense per conjugation. No universal automatic mood or de/zero-de rule is claimed.

objectives.description: Track people, objects and propositions across sentences; distinguish interrogative and relative reference.
objectives.rationale: Human relative quien, place donde and known-manner como are selected with bounded indicative/preposition frames. A1 articles/demonstratives/subject/interrogative/que-relative and A2-F009–034/121–125 indefinite/possessive/clitic/tonic systems remain prerequisites; proposition-anaphoric esto/eso/lo and indirect questions are scope extensions, not automatic new words. Required singular/plural/gender/person agreement, governed preposition and unaccented relative versus accented interrogative contrast are explicit. Free/unknown-reference subjunctive relatives and extensive explanatory relatives remain B2 comparison.

objectives.description: Distinguish reciprocal, impersonal and passive-reflexive constructions from earlier reflexive or dative-replacement se.
objectives.rationale: Reciprocal, impersonal and passive-reflexive uses are separately analyzed with agreement and object constraints. A1-F030 reflexive and A2-F030 dative replacement are not substitutes. A1-D/W cómo se dice and A2-D se puede bounded constructions retain their earlier introduction even if productive system is proposed B1. Form-versus-sense global policy may host all three under one se entry, but analyses cannot be collapsed; accidental responsibility-mitigating se+me and broad middle voice remain later comparison.

objectives.description: Describe outline and orientation without requiring an unbounded geometry syllabus.
objectives.rationale: Point/line/outline/side, round/three-sided/four-right-angle shapes, horizontal/vertical/diagonal and flat surface are enumerated. A2-F134 redondo/135 cuadrado supply earlier shape adjectives; noun square and triangular/rectangular derivatives are bounded role/family requirements, not automatically unique words. No false square/rectangle mutual exclusion. Higher geometry curves/axes/dimensional science belongs W/later.

objectives.description: Contrast consistency, texture, finish and moisture with earlier practical states.
objectives.rationale: Solid/liquid, hard/soft, fragile/flexible, tactile smoothness, wetting/moisture, protection/wrapping/coating are enumerated. A2-F136–138 strength/dry/wet, A2-H141 secar and existing repair states are reused; A2-P086 straight hair versus surface liso remains distinct. Paint coating versus exact earlier art-painting ID and quiet-state granularity are explicit. Hydrating skin products, irrigation, repairs and cleaning outcomes remain P/H/S owners; chemical surface-finishing systems stay later.

objectives.description: Identify additional everyday materials and manufacture, with cross-cell ownership preserved.
objectives.rationale: Steel/iron/aluminium, gold/silver, leather synonym, silk and synthetic-origin contrast are bounded choices. A2-F139–145 wood/plastic/metal/cloth/hide/glass and material de, A2-H107–108 cotton/wool/110 leather-piel and A2-S177 cardboard are named earlier dependencies; A1-S material relevel tensions remain global. Stone and natural-material source use are S crosslinks, not hidden guaranteed unique counts. Additional alloys/fibres/atomic-composition science is W/later; no every-PCIC-material quota.

objectives.description: Distinguish visibility, sound, flavor and smell in literal descriptions.
objectives.rationale: Visible/invisible/bright, sound/silence/voice/source sounding/noisy/quiet and aloud/low-voice, taste/smell nouns and predicates plus bitter taste are explicit. A1 sight/quiet-place baseline and A2 hearing/taste-action/earlier tastes remain linked or named. B1-P050–053 concurrent tactile/odor/taste matches and perception-versus-emission oler are explicit. Sound/flavor intensity strong/gentle and volume high/low are bounded adjective-role families; basic colors remain A1, coating color is selected. Voice pitch/scientific acoustics and elaborate hue palette are later/C/W work.

objectives.description: Reconcile age, access and cleanliness notions with prior people/home/travel selections.
objectives.rationale: An event anniversary, obstructed passage and earlier waste identity are explicit. A1-P age/cumplir/birth-anniversary and A2-P life stages/state forms, A2-T infrastructure/access and H clean/dirty/drying/cleaning proposals remain actual topical dependencies; B1 general notions5.13–15 do not reintroduce them. Age appearance uses selected parecer plus earlier age nouns, not a new word for each phrase. Advanced generation/life-phase/aging and industrial cleaning vocabulary remains P/H/S/later.

objectives.description: Assess attractiveness, quality, acceptability, adequacy and conformity.
objectives.rationale: Positive/negative intensified appraisal, beauty, evaluative success/failure nouns, apparent outcome, acceptance and advantage/drawback are enumerated. A1 good/bad/beautiful/ugly and A2-F152–160 admiration/perfect/useful/important/adequate remain earlier. Estupendo A2-D095 and outcome A2-W048 retain exact earlier meanings; parecer evaluator A2 conflict remains explicit. Price/value general6.2 uses earlier H price/discount/offer/payment and scalar-change forms, with limited B1-H price negotiation ownership. Full persuasive criticism and investment valuation stay B2–C2.

objectives.description: Assess correctness, clarity and relative simplicity; name correction and organization actions.
objectives.rationale: Correct/incorrect/error/correct/review, understandable versus visually light claro, simple/complicated and organization actions are enumerated with earlier W/T/H matches. A1 fácil/difícil and A2-F162–165 question/answer remain prerequisites. Source-correct exact numbers and task-specific correction families are not all new words. Advanced analytical classification/ambiguity/counterevidence rhetoric is later; routine earlier correction is not falsely delayed to B1.

objectives.description: Describe interest, attempted and successful outcomes, usefulness, competence and importance.
objectives.rationale: Interest, success, attempt/attainment, solving/use of opportunity, practical usefulness/function/purpose, practice/experience and importance/indifference are enumerated. Practical-knowledge experiencia B1 versus exact A2-W010 and practice A1-W073 versus A2-C030 remain explicit. A2-C041–042 winning/losing and existing prize/game/contest context remain C; A1-W work-income ganar is not sporting success. Advanced competence taxonomy and every victory/prize synonym are not required by this bounded scenario.

objectives.description: Distinguish assumption, realization, imagination, recollection and their evidence/complement requirements.
objectives.rationale: Assumption, guessing, imagining/dreams, realization, surprise, thought/belief/recall, familiarity and understanding have selected or exact earlier rows. The baseline dream/sleepiness distinction, cognitive versus intent/taste saber/pensar, P/W/D introduction conflicts and selected preposition/finite complements are explicit. Belief-in religious object belongs S/P; mental-ability traits P/W; detailed evidence analysis/interpretation and recall-versus-recognition science remain later. A new complex example is never the sole level rationale.

objectives.description: Describe an explanation or account and report its content without confusing a message with a proposition.
objectives.rationale: Explaining/explanation, telling an account, summary, expression and dialogue are enumerated; A2-D054 telling and090 explaining retain earlier meanings. A1-W word/sentence/text/reading-writing and A2-F question/answer plus A2-C news/message/communication and W written-task proposals remain prerequisites. Reported content uses bounded present reporting, indicative factual clauses and selected indirect questions; past-shift mastery and rhetorical argument systems remain later. Media-interview versus baseline job-interview and history subject versus story/event belong C/W, not collapsed here.

objectives.description: Connect a modest viewpoint, contrast and conclusion; coordinate lexical and discourse ownership.
objectives.rationale: Personal viewpoint, aspect-organizing pair, last/next/final and fortune markers, agreement/opinion and consequence/concession are explicit. A2-D163–165 same B1 plan phrases and A2-D005 agreement remain actual crosslinks; por último retains A2-D049. Four B2 baseline contrast/conclusion markers are comparison rows, not hidden B1 additions. D owns turn-taking/social/repair and wider rhetorical register; F supplies these lexical/grammatical relations without claiming D complete.

objectives.description: Retain earlier identity, articles, demonstratives, subject/object paradigms, cardinal/time bases and immediate action senses.
objectives.rationale: A1-F-001–297 and A2-F-001–186 are controller-reviewed enumeration proposals, not a globally adjudicated inventory. Reuse their same meanings; B1 practice does not create new introductions. Specific disputed constructions below remain subject to adjudication.

objectives.description: Realize the selected senses through bounded B1 tense and mood paradigms, not a new entry for every inflection.
objectives.rationale: Prerequisite authoring: retain A2 present/imperfect/preterite/present-perfect/progressive; add productive simple future, polite/modest/modal simple conditional, past-before-past pluperfect, present subjunctive in selected desire/evaluation/future-temporal/purpose/doubt uses, and negative imperative with clitic proclisis. Include regular three-conjugation paradigms and the irregular families required by selected lemmas. Regional past/future preferences, vos/vosotros/ustedes and clitic placement must be labeled. Counterfactual si+imperfect subjunctive, past subjunctive and future/conditional perfect systems remain B2 comparison work, not implicitly approved B1.

objectives.description: Close bounded reference, numeral and derivational paradigms without inflating lexical counts.
objectives.rationale: Reuse A1-F numeral bases and A2-F possessive/clitic systems. Ordinals11–20 gender/number and preferred variants; percentages with decimal and de-complement; -ísimo agreement/spelling and -ito pragmatic restrictions; productive -mente stress retention need forms/QA, not every derivative as a guaranteed new sense. Relative clauses, complement selection and anaphoric article use need independent form-versus-meaning adjudication.

objectives.description: Keep domain-specific examples and prior narrower senses with their actual topical owners.
objectives.rationale: P owns life stages/body/feelings; H recipe/household/purchase items and units; T routes/services; W study/professional/science; C media/arts/leisure; S manufacture/environment. Explicit lower-row references will identify retained meanings and disputed placements, not excuse missing B1 core contrasts.

objectives.description: Verify written sound risks now and actual connected-speech performance at later authoring/review gates.
objectives.rationale: A1/A2 sound-symbol, alphabet/letter names, numbers and basic speech-act prosody remain prerequisites. B1 selected MWE/periphrase/clitic and clause groups need word stress, linkage, information-focus and contrastive/courtesy/doubt intonation QA. Distinguish written accent and regional diphthong/hiatus realizations. Later es-ES routing/playback and physical risk-stratified listening, plus Spanish/Slovak editorial review, remain mandatory; this AI text review is not listening/native signoff.

objectives.description: Account explicitly for pressure measurement and specialized general-notion science beyond practical connected narration.
frameworkSections: General notions2.6.10 pressure; specific notions16 science/technology
objectives.rationale: PCIC general2.6.10 B1 contains a pressure-unit example, but scientific pressure-unit production is not needed by the approved F connected-narration and everyday-comparison scenarios. B1-W must independently dispose scientific measuring/forecast/product-label needs; this is not a claim that pressure is officially B2 or covered by a token unit row. Do not add a chemistry/physics vocabulary quota to F merely from one framework example.

selections.levelRationale: Retain provisional B1 for the neutral occurrence predicate needed to name an incident, independent of the length of its account.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 ser locates an event; A2 pasar route-through is not event occurrence. A2-D055 proposes pasar for event-happening, so a short occurrence statement is already available at A2; keeping this synonym at B1 is an added-form selection, not withholding the event concept.

selections.formNotes: Mostly third-person ocurre/ocurren; past ocurrió/ocurrieron; not ocurrírsele an idea.
selections.pronunciationNotes: O-cu-RRIR; medial rr trill and final stress.
uncertainties: General notions1.5 puts this lemma under B2; B1 recommendation is independent lexical utility, not a claim of PCIC B1 certification.

selections.levelRationale: A second neutral occurrence verb is useful for understanding ordinary incident reports; propose B1 with visible framework tension.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Same semantic neighborhood as ocurrir, not the succession/inheritance sense of suceder. A2-D055 proposes pasar for event-happening, so a short occurrence statement is already available at A2; keeping this synonym at B1 is an added-form selection, not withholding the event concept.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Sucede/sucedió; event subject; intransitive.
uncertainties: General notions1.5 lists this under B2; compare synonym utility and avoid requiring both as a quota.

selections.sense: become aware of a fact that was not previously recognized
selections.levelRationale: The transition into awareness is explicit in general notions7.1 B1 and is distinct from static knowledge.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 saber fact and A2 recordar retrieval do not encode discovery.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Me doy cuenta de + noun/de que + clause; di/diste/dio; retain de before que.
selections.pronunciationNotes: CUEN-ta diphthong; doy one syllable; de que unstressed.
uncertainties: Grammar12.2.5 reprises the governed complement in B2; later formal generalization does not establish a later minimum.

selections.sense: unexpectedly and with little warning
selections.levelRationale: Sudden onset is a useful event-relation contrast, not simply another timestamp.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 ahora and A2 entonces time identify when, not abruptness.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Invariable; clause-initial or near event predicate.
selections.pronunciationNotes: de re-PEN-te; initial r of repente is a trill.
uncertainties: Current A2-D094 proposes the exact sudden/unexpected meaning at A2; source-level comparison and global adjudication must settle A2 versus baseline B1, not create two senses.

selections.sense: during the time that another ongoing event happens
selections.levelRationale: B1 grammar15.3.1 explicitly handles simultaneous duration with indicative.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2 cuando routine time and durante+noun do not by themselves teach a durative finite subordinate clause.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Mientras + indicative for asserted overlapping events; future/conditional 'as long as' uses are outside this row.
selections.pronunciationNotes: MIEN-tras; ie diphthong and tr cluster.

selections.sense: at the last stage or as the eventual outcome
selections.levelRationale: Retain the baseline eventual-endpoint use with general notions4.3.8 B1 support.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 al final de a street is a physical endpoint, not this temporal/discourse relation.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Invariable al final; optional de+event noun for temporal boundary; not en fin reformulation.
selections.pronunciationNotes: al fi-NAL; final stress, no accent mark.
uncertainties: Baseline groups last-stage and eventual-outcome readings; global granularity may keep usage variants rather than split.
Current A2-D093 proposes the same last-stage/eventual-outcome meaning at A2. Preserve this explicit A2 versus baseline B1 conflict for global decision.

selections.sense: as a precaution against an uncertain possibility
selections.levelRationale: A precaution relation lets a learner state why a contingency measure is taken without asserting the contingency.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2 si expresses an open real condition; this signals precaution rather than cause already known.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Can stand alone after an action or introduce an indicative contingency; do not prescribe si+future indicative.
selections.pronunciationNotes: por si a-CA-so; vowel contact may link naturally.
uncertainties: Coordinate with B1-D and planned en caso de; phrase and conjunction-like construction may share one sense.

selections.sense: introduce a fact that does not prevent the main event
selections.levelRationale: B1 grammar15.3.9 explicitly selects factual concession with indicative.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 pero opposes statements; aunque makes one a conceded subordinate fact.
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic unless usage notes state otherwise; es-ES audio
selections.formNotes: Aunque+indicative for newly asserted factual information; subjunctive concessive readings require later scope decisions.
selections.pronunciationNotes: AUN-que usually two syllables; qu /k/, u silent.

selections.sense: time allowed to complete a task or meet an obligation
selections.levelRationale: Retain provisional B1 for the allowed interval, which directly supports a bounded deadline account.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 fecha is a date and A2 durar elapsed extent; neither supplies the allowed-time limit.
